hadith:
Invoking Allah for Rain (Istisqaa) - Narrated Aisha:

Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw the rain, he used to say, "O Allah! Let it be a strong fruitful rain."
message: In the Name of Allah—the Most Beneficent, Most Merciful
name:
Al Jabbaar - الْجَبَّارُ - The Compeller

Al Jabbaar, meaning 'The Compeller' or 'The Restorer', reflects Allah's supreme ability to enforce His will upon creation. It emphasizes His power to rectify and restore all that is broken or unjust. This name highlights Allah's dominion over the universe, ensuring that justice and order prevail according to His divine plan.
verse:
Al-Mulk - The Sovereignty - 67:17

Or do you feel secure that the One Who is in heaven will not unleash upon you a storm of stones. Only then would you know how ˹serious˺ My warning was!
